# LasyaAitech

LasyaAitech is a software and AI engineering company based in Hyderabad, India.
We build AI agents and MCP servers, generative AI and LLM applications, chatbots,
machine learning systems, mobile apps, web platforms and APIs — either as a
delivery partner or as a dedicated team embedded with yours.

## Get a quote

One quotation process covers every service below. Share a brief, a budget range
and a timeline and we reply within one business day with scope, team shape and
milestones.

- Software, app and AI development quote: https://lasyaaitech.com/get-a-free-quote
- AI development quote and pricing: https://lasyaaitech.com/ai-free-quote
